topic: The Mystery of Pi: Definition and Historical Evolution

sections.title: The Hook: The Constant Ratio
lecture_lines: Circles exist in every size.
A coin is a circle.
A plate is a circle.
A Ferris wheel is a circle.
All share a special constant ratio.
animations: Create a circle on screen (Color: #FFFFFF) that transitions into a.
Draw a diameter line across the circle (Color: #FFFFFF).
Label circumference C and diameter D (Color: #FFFFFF).
Highlight ratio of C/D on screen (Color: #FFFF00) next to a floating.
Fade in text: C/D is always constant! (Color: #FF00FF).

sections.title: Defining Pi (π)
lecture_lines: Pi is circumference divided by diameter.
We write this as C equals Pi times d.
Pi is an irrational number.
It never ends and never repeats.
It is a fundamental mathematical constant.
animations: Display circle with diameter D (Color: #00FFFF).
Show circumference C as a wrapped line (Color: #00FF00).
Display the mathematical ratio C/D = π (Color: #FF4500).
Display the decimal start of π (3.14159...) (Color: #FF4500).
Animate the digits trailing into infinity (Color: #FF4500).

sections.title: Historical Quest: Archimedes’ Method
lecture_lines: Archimedes used shapes to trap Pi.
He inscribed polygons inside a circle.
He circumscribed polygons outside the circle.
Adding more sides makes a better estimate.
The polygon shape approaches a circle.
animations: Draw a hexagon inscribed in a circle (Color: #FFD700).
Draw a hexagon circumscribed around the circle (Color: #FFD700).
Increase side count of both polygons (Color: #FFD700).
Animate polygons converging toward the circle shape (Color: #FFD700).
Display narrowing range of Pi estimate (Color: #ADFF2F).

sections.title: Modern Pursuit and Significance
lecture_lines: Today computers calculate trillions of digits.
Pi is vital for modern technology.
GPS relies on Pi for accuracy.
animations: Rapidly display digits of π on screen (Color: #1E90FF).
Show satellites orbiting (Color: #FFA500).
Highlight formula involving π for orbit calculation (Color: #FF69B4).

sections.title: Summary and Conclusion
lecture_lines: Pi links diameter to circumference.
It transcends time and scale.
Pi is a fundamental geometric bridge.
animations: Flash the relation C/D = π (Color: #FFFFFF).
Briefly show Archimedes method converging to circle (Color: #FFFF00).
Animate π symbol glowing as bridge connecting concepts (Color: #FF00FF).
